connection.text: Connection Name*Give your connection a unique name to help you identify it in the future.Endpoint URL*Provide the Testmo instance URL (e.g., https://yourorganization.testmo.net/api/v1)API Token*Generate an API token from your Testmo account settings: Settings → APIProxyAdd a proxy if you cannot access Testmo directly.Custom Rate LimitBy default, DevLake will not limit API requests per hour.
